_comment: Scenarios are data. 'runnable_now' marks what works against the SHIPPED
ROM today; everything else is blocked on the dev build (which adds the
AUTO WORKER menu entry) and/or a symbol file for save-block reads.
Steps run in order, then assertions evaluate. An assertion that cannot be

scenarios.name: emulator-boots-rom
scenarios.why: Baseline. If this fails nothing else means anything.

scenarios.name: gmain-discoverable-without-symbols
scenarios.why: The harness must work on a stripped ROM, so it has to find gMain by behaviour rather than by symbol table.

scenarios.name: no-injection-when-agent-off
scenarios.why: Control case. With Auto Worker off, cooked and raw key fields must agree -- anything else means something is writing input behind the player's back.

scenarios.name: not-in-battle-on-title
scenarios.why: Sanity-checks the inBattle bit against a state we know, so battle assertions elsewhere can be trusted.

scenarios.name: generated-state-loads-and-resumes
scenarios.why: Proves the save-state path end to end on a real generated state: load it, run on, and confirm the machine is still executing rather than wedged.

scenarios.name: B-returns-control-within-one-frame
scenarios.why: The single most important safety property. After a human B press the agent must inject nothing, ever, on the very next frame.
scenarios.blocked_on: dev build with AUTO WORKER menu entry

scenarios.name: agent-injects-when-enabled
scenarios.why: The converse of the control case: if enabling Auto Worker produces no injection signature, the choke point is wrong.
scenarios.blocked_on: dev build with AUTO WORKER menu entry

scenarios.name: agent-never-opens-save-menu
scenarios.why: The agent is structurally forbidden from saving; a corrupted save is the one unrecoverable outcome.

scenarios.name: wild-battle-is-won-not-spammed
scenarios.why: Checks the battle AI actually drives the player's battler: a type-disadvantaged lead must win or switch rather than repeat a resisted move.

scenarios.name: heals-at-pokemon-centre
scenarios.why: The first real navigation test: route to the nurse and heal without being told where she is.

scenarios.name: completes-first-objective-from-new-game
scenarios.why: End-to-end: from a fresh boot the agent should clear objective 1 unaided. This is the scenario that decides whether the quest chain is real.
